taskContract.primaryJob: Let a studio owner (1–20 people) compare Solo, Studio and Firm and start a 30-day trial with the right plan and billing cadence
taskContract.data: variant-output/shared/pricing-data.ts, which re-exports components/plans.ts (plans, annualDiscount, faqs) and the CurrencyProvider context
requiredFunctions: toggle yearly/monthly billing with the 20% annual discount
switch display currency USD/EUR/GBP through useCurrency
see price, seats and features for each plan
follow each plan's call to action to /signup?plan=<id>&billing=<annual|monthly>
taskContract.successCriteria: The visitor can tell which plan fits, what each charge is and when it lands, before clicking the call to action

designDeclaration.user_context: Owner of a 1–20 person studio comparing plans before a trial
designDeclaration.primary_job: Choose the plan that fits the team and start the trial with the intended billing cadence
designDeclaration.success_moment: Clicking the plan's call to action knowing the seat limit, the exact amount billed and that nothing is charged for 30 days
designDeclaration.trust_boundary: Prices are the project's USD list prices; EUR/GBP amounts are labelled as approximate conversions; the first-charge date is computed from the visitor's clock and labelled 'on or after'
hierarchy: price with billing cadence and the amount actually charged
call to action with trial terms
non_negotiables: never hide that yearly pricing is billed once a year
no invented social proof, metrics or testimonials
keep the project's own copy; no taglines

recommendation.reason: Seat limits are the one dimension that separates the plans for this audience, and A answers 'which plan fits' before asking the visitor to read anything. Hypotheses, untested: A shortens time-to-choice for visitors who know their team size; B wins when the decision is Studio vs Firm on a specific capability; C reduces billing surprises. Tested so far: all three keep the same data, controls and links, pass the static gates and render at 1200px and 390px.

comparison.optimizes: 先回答“哪个方案适合我”：输入团队人数后，适配的方案被标出，并说明距离下一档还剩多少席位；三张卡片并列，主按钮只落在适配方案上。
comparison.tradeoff: 比较之前多了一步输入；把席位数当作首要决策维度，对关心具体功能（审批流、多币种）的访客帮助有限；功能仍以“Everything in Solo”的累加写法呈现。
comparison.bestFor: 清楚自己团队规模、想快速得到答案的工作室负责人；首次访问定价页的流量。

comparison.optimizes: 跨方案逐项比较：一张功能×方案矩阵，“Everything in Solo”被展开成真实行并按首次出现的方案分组，“只看差异”开关隐藏三档都有的行，价格和按钮固定在表头随滚动可见。
comparison.tradeoff: 信息密度最高，首屏阅读慢，价格不如卡片醒目；默认突出 Studio 列是未经验证的假设；窄屏需用方案切换器一次只看一列。
comparison.bestFor: 在 Studio 与 Firm 之间犹豫、看重某项具体能力的团队；需要把页面转给会计或合伙人逐项核对的场景。

comparison.optimizes: 先讲清钱怎么扣：单栏阅读式排版，每个方案同时显示年付与月付两套价格和全年总额，按钮上方写明首笔扣款金额与日期，页面末尾用时间线交代 Day 0 / Day 30 / 首次扣款。
comparison.tradeoff: 页面最长、视觉冲击最弱，没有突出任何一档，三个主按钮纵向排列；不回答“哪档适合我”，仍需访客自己对照席位。
comparison.bestFor: 谨慎型买家、要向会计或合伙人解释费用的人、以及 Firm 这类走“Talk to us”路径的大团队；也适合作为结账前的条款确认页。

notes: Brand-locked exploration: fonts, colors and controls identical across A/B/C; layout, hierarchy and density differ.
Billed amounts are shown exactly (e.g. $9.60) instead of the current page's rounding, because this is a money page.
Default exports wrap the page in CurrencyProvider for the standalone preview; integrate the named PricingPageX export because app/layout.tsx already provides the context.
shared/preview-fonts.css loads the brand fonts from Google Fonts for the preview only; the project itself does not load them.
